summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of a $750 million offering of 5.625% Senior Notes due 2031 by its subsidiary. The notes were issued under an indenture with Computershare Trust Company as trustee and sold to QIBs under Rule 144A and offshore under Regulation S. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. There is no change of control, premium, or event-driven catalyst. What to watch: normal debt service and covenant compliance; no risk-arb angle.
